title: Lightly Garlicky Jamaican Buckwheat Toast
description: A quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring buckwheat flour and toast with a hint of garlic, perfect for a snack or light meal. This raw-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, water, minced garlic, chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Heat the coconut oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour the buckwheat mixture into the pan and cook for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is lightly browned.
Flip the buckwheat mixture over and cook for another 2 minutes, until the other side is also lightly browned.
Meanwhile, toast the whole wheat bread until it is lightly browned.
Once the buckwheat mixture is cooked, place it on top of the toasted bread.
Cut the bread into halves or quarters, depending on your preference.
Serve the lightly garlicky Jamaican buckwheat toast immediately and enjoy.
